     ╭▸ src\AcquisitionAuthority.sol:1134:34
     │
1134 │         if (!ok || size != 32 || bytes4(result) != _ERC1271_MAGIC) revert InvalidSignature();
     │                                  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
     │
     ├ note: consider disabling this lint if you're certain the cast is safe
     │       
     │       // casting to 'bytes4' is safe because [explain why]
     │       // forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)
     │       
     │       
     ╰ help: https://book.getfoundry.sh/reference/forge/forge-lint#unsafe-typecast

disposition.rationale: _validateSignature executes the bounded ERC1271 staticcall, then requires success, exactly 32 returned bytes, post-call gas reserve and the leading bytes4 equal ERC1271 magic. bytes4(result) intentionally selects the ABI bytes4 prefix; the remaining word padding is not an amount, identity, or authorization value discarded by an unsafe numeric cast.
